description: A subtle, NE–SW–oriented linear negative feature approximately 600 m long and 3–5 m wide, visible as a shallow trench (slope <2°, negative plan curvature) in the LiDAR-derived DTM. This feature coincides with a narrow, low-NIR–reflectance band suggesting higher soil moisture or terra preta–type enrichment along its trace.

A convex, elongated plateau or embankment c. 100 m × 10–15 m, appearing as a ridge in the DTM with mild positive curvature. In the NIR image it shows anomalous high reflectance at its crest and adjacent low-reflectance swales, consistent with raised-field agriculture or a platform serviced by parallel drainage ditches.
